newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia lowers November palm olein export tax.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia lowers November palm olein export tax.

text.p: Indonesia's export tax on RBD palm olein has been lowered to $18.75/tonne in November from $30.00 in October, the Finance Ministry said on Thursday.
The tax on crude palm oil was reduced to $28/tonne from $35.28 last month, the ministry said in a statement.
The tax on RBD palm oil was $19.20/tonne compared with $25.76 in October, while that on crude olein was $22.50 in November against $33.75 last month.

The taxes, introduced in September 1994, are based on the composite average of international prices in the last two weeks of the previous month and are aimed at ensuring sufficient supply and price stability in the local market.
